title: The FBI confirms Iran-linked Handala breached Kash Patel's personal email and the data accessed was "historical in nature" and involves no government info (TechCrunch)
summary: TechCrunch: The FBI confirms Iran-linked Handala breached Kash Patel's personal email and the data accessed was “historical in nature” and involves no government info — Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai Zack Whittaker — A hacking group backed by the Iranian government dubbed “Handala” …
